## Reason codes and chargeback windows
Each dispute reason code has its own window, counted in days from the
transaction date. A dispute opened after the window closes is not eligible.

|---|---|

Limit operations

Limits are tracked on calendar days, not business days. The daily window runs
from 00:00 to 23:59 CET.

Glossary
## Chargeback window
The number of days, counted from the transaction date, during which a dispute
may be raised under a given reason code.

Dispute handling process
## Review timelines
The review target is 10 business days for card reason codes and 20 business
days for transfer reason codes. Complex cases involving a foreign acquirer may
run to 45 calendar days; the customer is notified when that happens.

Verta tariff schedule
## FX spreads by tier
The spread is applied over the mid-market rate only after the free monthly
conversion allowance is exhausted.

| Tier | FX spread | Free monthly conversion allowance |
|---|---|---|
| Tier 1 | 1.5% | EUR 500 |
| Tier 2 | 0.9% | EUR 1,000 |

Verta tariff schedule
## Account tiers
Verta offers three account tiers: Tier 1, Tier 2 and Tier 3. The tier
determines the FX spread, the free monthly conversion allowance and the
transfer limits.

Currency conversion guide
## How a conversion is priced
A conversion quote has these components, in order: the mid-market rate for the
currency pair; the tier spread (a percentage of the gross converted amount);
the free monthly conversion allowance. If the whole conversion fits within the
customer's remaining monthly allowance, no spread is charged. Once the
allowance is exhausted, the full tier spread applies to the conversion.

Currency conversion operations
## Allowance accounting
The free monthly conversion allowance is counted in EUR equivalent and resets on
the first calendar day of each month. Allowance consumption is recorded at
settlement. A conversion that would cross the allowance boundary has the tier
spread applied to the entire conversion, not only to the portion above the
boundary.

## Eligibility conditions
A dispute is eligible only if all of the following hold: the reason code is
valid; the transaction status is settled; the transaction date is within the

open new disputes until the review concludes).

Fee details
## Card payment fee
Card payments carry a percentage fee on the EUR equivalent. No flat fee
applies.

Fee details
## How the SWIFT fee is composed
A SWIFT transfer carries a flat fee plus a percentage of the EUR equivalent of
the amount sent. Correspondent bank charges deducted en route are outside the
control of Verta and are not refunded.

Fee details
## Fee refunds
A fee is refunded only when the underlying transaction is reversed because of a
Verta error. Fees on customer-initiated reversals are not refunded.

## FX spreads by tier
The spread is applied over the mid-market rate only after the free monthly
conversion allowance is exhausted.

| Tier | FX spread | Free monthly conversion allowance |

Currency conversion guide
## How a conversion is priced
A conversion quote has these components, in order: the mid-market rate for the
currency pair; the tier spread (a percentage of the gross converted amount);
the free monthly conversion allowance. If the whole conversion fits within the
customer's remaining monthly allowance, no spread is charged. Once the
allowance is exhausted, the full tier spread applies to the conversion.

Verta tariff schedule
## Account tiers
Verta offers three account tiers: Tier 1, Tier 2 and Tier 3. The tier
determines the FX spread, the free monthly conversion allowance and the
transfer limits.

Onboarding and tiers
## Tier benefits
A higher tier lowers the FX spread, raises the free monthly conversion
allowance and raises both transfer limits.
